create_iterative_imputer: create an IterativeImputer to impute missing values by modeling each feature as a function of other features
fit_iterative_imputer: fit an IterativeImputer on training data with missing values to learn imputation models for each feature
transform_missing_data: transform new data by imputing missing values using the fitted IterativeImputer models
impute_with_bayesian_ridge: impute missing values using IterativeImputer with BayesianRidge estimator for multivariate imputation
sample_posterior_imputation: sample from the predictive posterior of the fitted estimator for multiple imputations with sample_posterior=True
